meta.question: What are we building, by when, and how will we deliver it?
meta.title: Kickoff: customer self-service portal
meta.author: Project lead
meta.footer: Example kickoff one-pager. Names, dates and figures are illustrative.

answer.headline: We will launch a self-service portal for invoices and account changes by 26/02/2027, delivered in two phased releases rather than one big launch.
answer.text: Customers currently email or phone for routine requests. The portal lets them do these themselves, freeing the support team for harder cases.
points: Scope: view and download invoices, update contact details, raise a request
Delivery: phased, with a pilot group before full launch
Decision needed by 31/10/2026: confirm the phased option and pilot customers

items.title: Fewer routine contacts
items.text: Move invoice copies and address changes to self-service.

items.title: Faster answers for customers
items.text: Available at any time, not only in office hours.

items.title: No loss of security
items.text: Same sign-in and access checks as existing systems.

items.title: Kickoff and discovery
items.text: Interview support staff and five customers.

items.title: Release 1: pilot
items.text: Invoices only, for a pilot group of customers.

items.title: Release 2: full launch
items.text: All customers; contact details and requests added.

options.name: Phased (pilot, then full)
options.summary: Ship invoices to a pilot group first, then add features.
pros: Lower risk if something goes wrong
cons: Two releases to plan and communicate
options.verdict: Lower risk; worth the extra release.

options.name: Single launch
options.summary: Build everything, then launch to all customers at once.
cons: Problems found late affect every customer
No value delivered until the end

blocks.title: Top risks
blocks.label: Risks
blocks.body:
- **Billing data access** may need work from the finance systems team; confirm by 04/12/2026.
- **Pilot customers** must be chosen early to keep the 15/01/2027 date.
- **Holiday period** reduces capacity in late December.

items.text: Sponsor approves scope and phased delivery
Pilot customer list agreed with account managers
Success measures agreed (contact volume, portal use)
Weekly update slot booked with stakeholders
